description: Strix brings AI penetration testing and vulnerability management into ChatGPT. Review recent tests, prioritize open findings by severity, and inspect evidence and remediation steps. Start tests against your authorized web applications, APIs, and repositories; retest findings; and open fix pull requests or tickets through connected integrations. Check pull request security reviews and supply-chain findings, manage recurring schedules and assets, and summarize your workspace's security activity. Sign in with your Strix account using OAuth. Access follows your Strix workspace role and resource permissions. Starting tests, retests, reviews, and other security workflows may use Strix credits and send traffic to the selected targets. Some capabilities require an eligible Strix plan.

defaultPrompt: Show my open critical and high vulnerabilities, with evidence and recommended fixes.
Summarize this week's security activity: scans, new findings, fixed findings, and pull request reviews.
Help me start a penetration test of one of my verified assets, showing the target and credit cost before starting.
